It is evident that…: Look at the empty plates and happy faces; it is evident that everyone enjoyed the dinner you cooked.
看看空盤子和開心的臉孔，顯然大家都很喜歡你煮的晚餐。
be evident from the data: The rise in sales after the TV ad should be evident from the data in this monthly report.
電視廣告播出後銷售量的成長，從這份月報的數據中應可明顯看出。
with evident pleasure: The little girl opened her birthday present with evident pleasure and hugged her grandmother tightly.
小女孩顯然很高興地打開生日禮物，並緊緊抱住她的奶奶。
self-evident: To most people it seems self-evident that clean water and fresh air are necessary for good health.
對大多數人來說，乾淨的水和新鮮空氣是健康所必需的，這似乎是不證自明的。
exceptional talent: She showed exceptional talent on the piano at age five, so her parents sent her to a music school.
她五歲時就在鋼琴上展現非凡的天賦，所以她的父母送她去讀音樂學校。
in exceptional circumstances: Students may only take the final exam late in exceptional circumstances, such as a serious illness.
學生只有在特殊情況下，例如生重病，才可以延後參加期末考。
an exceptional student: As an exceptional student who skipped two grades, Tom started university when he was only fifteen.
身為跳級兩次的資優生，湯姆只有十五歲就上了大學。
excessive drinking: The doctor warned him that excessive drinking every weekend could seriously damage his liver.
醫生警告他，每個週末過量飲酒可能會嚴重傷害他的肝臟。
excessive force: The video showed the officers using excessive force on a man who was not even fighting back.
影片顯示員警對一名根本沒有反抗的男子使用過度武力。
excessive demands: The workers went on strike because the boss kept making excessive demands, like working every Sunday for free.
工人們發起罷工，因為老闆一再提出過分的要求，像是每個星期天無償上班。
an excessive amount of: Eating an excessive amount of sugar every day can lead to weight gain and tooth problems.
每天吃過多的糖會導致體重增加和牙齒問題。
an exclusive interview: The famous singer refused to talk to other reporters but gave our magazine an exclusive interview.
那位知名歌手拒絕和其他記者交談，卻給了我們雜誌一個獨家專訪。
an exclusive club: Only rich members who pay a huge yearly fee can enter that exclusive club downtown.
只有付得起高額年費的有錢會員才能進入市中心那家會員制高級俱樂部。
mutually exclusive: Some people think that having a career and raising a family are mutually exclusive, but many parents do both.
有些人認為發展事業和養育家庭是互相排斥的，但許多父母兩者兼顧。
exclusive rights: The company paid millions of dollars for exclusive rights to show the World Cup on TV in Taiwan.
這家公司花了數百萬美元取得在台灣電視播出世界盃的專屬權利。
exclusive of tax: The hotel room costs 3,000 dollars a night exclusive of tax, so the final bill will be higher.
這間飯店房間一晚三千元，不含稅，所以最後的帳單會更高。
an executive decision: Since the team could not agree on a date, the manager made an executive decision and chose Friday.
由於團隊無法對日期達成共識，經理做了高層決定，選定星期五。
the executive branch: In a democracy, the president leads the executive branch, while the lawmakers make the laws.
在民主國家，總統領導行政部門，而立法者負責制定法律。
a chief executive officer: After working at the company for twenty years, she was finally named a chief executive officer.
在這家公司工作二十年後，她終於被任命為執行長。
executive power: The new law gives the president more executive power to act quickly during natural disasters.
新法賦予總統更多行政權，以便在天災期間迅速採取行動。
an executive summary: The busy manager had no time to read the whole report, so she only read the executive summary on page one.
忙碌的經理沒時間讀完整份報告，所以她只讀了第一頁的摘要報告。
exotic plants: The botanical garden is full of exotic plants brought from rainforests in Africa and South America.
植物園裡滿是從非洲和南美洲雨林引進的外來植物。
exotic locations: The travel show takes viewers to exotic locations such as desert islands and ancient jungle temples.
這個旅遊節目帶觀眾前往充滿異國風情的地點，例如無人島和古老的叢林神廟。
exotic pets: Keeping exotic pets like snakes and lizards from other countries can be dangerous for native animals.
飼養來自其他國家的蛇和蜥蜴等異國寵物，可能會對本土動物造成危險。
at an experimental stage: The new cancer drug is still at an experimental stage and has only been tested on mice.
這種新的抗癌藥仍處於實驗階段，只在老鼠身上測試過。
experimental theater: In this experimental theater, the actors sometimes walk into the audience and ask people to join the show.
在這個實驗劇場裡，演員有時會走進觀眾席，邀請觀眾加入演出。
an experimental approach: The teacher tried an experimental approach, letting students design their own tests to see if they learned better.
老師嘗試了一種實驗性的做法，讓學生自己設計考題，看看他們是否學得更好。
explicit instructions: The nurse gave me explicit instructions to take the medicine twice a day after meals.
護理師給我明確的指示，要我每天飯後吃兩次藥。
be explicit about: If you want your roommate to stop playing loud music, you need to be explicit about it.
如果你希望室友別再大聲放音樂，你就必須把話明白說出來。
sexually explicit: The film was rated for adults only because it contains several sexually explicit scenes.
這部電影被列為限制級，因為它含有幾段露骨性內容的畫面。
an explicit warning: The sign on the beach gave an explicit warning that swimming is not allowed because of sharks.
海灘上的告示牌給出明確的警告：因為有鯊魚，禁止游泳。
